remaining_cautions.evidence_context: Some DBAASP rows convert paper-reported viability into cytotoxicity categories or omit greater-than qualifiers from MIC thresholds; these are retained as source_conflict in database_record_verification.json.

Local supplementary_original files are HTML pages linking to six remote DOCX additional files; no local DOCX/XLSX/PDF supplement payload was present. The final row-level activity/database decision uses primary XML/PDF tables and database JSONL, so no required activity value remains unsupported by local material.
Mechanism ontology is limited to physicochemical association, sequence motif association, and stability context; no direct molecular target mechanism is promoted.
